title: Missing features and delivery issues
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on missing features or items, with some praise for overall suitability but many fragments too vague to determine a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as very good overall and well suited for a couple.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention missing items on delivery, missing expected features, and poor instrument readability, though one example appears sentiment-labeled inconsistently.

mixed.summary: The mixed review likes the car but misses automatically sensing and opening doors found on a previous vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention ownership duration, unspecified annoyances, questions, setup discussions, and a panel gap without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: This topic is somewhat heterogeneous, combining missing features, delivery omissions, usability complaints, ownership-context remarks, and vague unresolved comments.
A large share of fragments are undetermined, so the concrete evidence for several issues is limited.
One negative-assigned example says "it is missing nothing at all," which conflicts with the assigned sentiment and limits confidence in that example.
Another negative-assigned example has fragment-level sentiment marked undetermined, so its complaint context may be incomplete.
